summary: All four occurrences describe acquiring or having a skin condition, with a zero-marked affected subject. No participant controls an external patient, and no agent-suppression reading is required for the Detransitive.
70/70 has an m-marked source of contagion, not an external agent. German angesteckt werden must not determine the Turoyo grammatical analysis.

The inherited entry distinguishes regular komgarwni in 77/15 from Detransitive migarwni and mgarwəno/mgarwanne. The semantic similarity is insufficient to collapse their form boxes; retain the distinction pending paradigm evidence.
Camels, dogs, horses and a human face instantiate the same disease-state meaning. The edition's Aussatz is retained as historical translation, without asserting a modern diagnosis.
Confirm the paradigmatic contrast between regular mgarwni and Detransitive migarwni. Is absence of i in 77/15 phonological or grammatical?
Confirm segmentation of mgarwanne in 113/13 as the plural Detransitive result form rather than a regular form with suffix contraction.
